method: STATIC code review of PR head from git objects; the PR's 36 tests NOT re-run (node blocked in this workspace); physical iPhone Shortcut run NOT performed

critical_question.q: Could a connected/possibly connected real-health user ever receive synthetic medical facts silently?
paths: importedHealth() returns {connected:false} when the request has no valid baymax_session cookie (cleared cookie, private mode, different browser, the phone's own browser while the Shortcut paired to the Mac browser's workspace) -> get-user-info returns demo profile 'Alex, 42, Type 2 diabetes, Metformin 500mg twice daily' as 'the current user'; only a notes field and the agent prompt label it synthetic; get-daily-metrics returns source:'demo' sample metrics (UI shows 'Sample data' badge, but user-info path has no badge tie)
status() requires workspace state.remember=='true'; if memory/consent is turned off the connection row remains but status->disconnected -> demo facts again

Postgres 42P01 (missing table, e.g. migration not applied or WRONG DATABASE - this project already has a known Neon project mismatch) returns disconnected -> demo data, contradicting the PR text 'a database outage does not substitute demo data' (other DB errors do throw = fail closed)
critical_question.verdict: FAIL for the expected NO; mitigations are prompt/UI-level, not enforced at the tool boundary
critical_question.repair: tool must fail closed (return UNKNOWN/NOT_PROVIDED, never a populated demo profile) unless an explicit demo-mode flag is set server-side; never infer 'not connected' from a missing cookie; surface source on every tool output and block demo-source facts in real-user sessions

verified_strengths: server middleware binds session from HttpOnly cookie and overwrites client-supplied request context (covers all Mastra routes incl. agent stream)
pairing/import/status all require saved workspace consent (remember=true)
connection key stored as hash only; rotation replaces hash immediately; revocation cascades day rows
exportedAt window enforced (+5 min future, -24 h) and per-day older snapshots ignored (>= guard)
missing categories modelled as null/unknown; summaries state 'Missing readings are unknown, not zero'
connected sessions get empty runs/checkins with explanatory notes; user-info returns 'Not provided' with empty lists

findings.text: synthetic/demo medical facts reachable for non-cookie / consent-off / missing-table sessions (see critical_question)
findings.scope: *P1 for real-health users; fine for synthetic demo

findings.text: disconnect/delete covers Postgres tables only; Mastra Observability DefaultExporter + LibSQLStore (file mastra.db) persist agent/tool spans; SensitiveDataFilter targets credential-like keys, not health values -> imported readings and chat likely retained in traces after disconnect (LIKELY from code; not executed)
imported readings and chat flow to an external model (neon/gpt-5-6-luna) with no deterministic compliance pre-gate (same class as earlier RT-01)
Shortcut/pairing over plain HTTP on the LAN sends bearer key + health summaries in clear (doc says hosted use should be HTTPS)
merge semantics metrics || jsonb_strip_nulls(new): a later null cannot clear a prior value; revoked iOS permissions/deleted Health data persist until disconnect
per-source max (not sum) selection can overstate if a third-party source logs more; documented but affects trend claims
no rate limiting/lockout on bearer-key import endpoint (256-bit key makes brute force impractical)

claim_ceiling: Static review only. No physical Shortcut run, no real readings used or committed.
